headlines.title: Arthur J. Gallagher Acquires Intelligent Communications Experiences For Undisclosed Terms
headlines.summary: (RTTNews) - Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. (AJG) announced Monday the acquisition of Melbourne, Victoria-based Intelligent Communications Experiences. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
